facts.text: Trinity Washington University is classified by the U.S. Department of Education as both a Minority Serving Institution and a Predominantly Black Institution, as well as an emerging Hispanic Serving Institution.

sources.title: Trinity 2020: Leadership for Racial Equity | Trinity DARE
sources.quote: Trinity is classified by the U.S. Department of Education as a Minority Serving Institution (MSI) and a Predominantly Black Institution (PBI) and, more recently, as an emerging Hispanic Serving Institution (HSI).
